SELECT mc.*, u.username AS username, u.email AS email, d.dept_name AS dept_name, r.name AS reviewed_by_name FROM member_claim mc LEFT JOIN user u ON mc.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON mc.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN user r ON mc.reviewed_by = r.user_id
AND mc.status = #{status}
AND (mc.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mc.student_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY mc.status ASC, mc.created_at DESC
